parameters.name: MaxResult
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default Value: 50. Maximum Value: 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token returned from a previous call to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: SettingName
parameters.description: The names of the associated resource rules.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the associated resource rules to query. Valid values:

- Enable: The rule is enabled.

- Disable: The rule is disabled.
